mech_summary: Thrown-javelin lightning caster-in-warrior-clothes: Lightning Fury releases massed chain-forks per throw for screen clears; Charged Strike point-deletes bosses. Neither needs attack rating.
Pure physical ranged attacker: Multishot fans arrows for density, Strafe autotargets sequential shots; damage entirely weapon-and-attack-speed scaled.
Plague Javelin blankets areas in overlapping poison clouds; damage-over-time identity with delayed kill confirmation.
Freezing Arrow converts bow shots into cold AOE bursts with hard crowd-freeze; control-forward ranged play.
1.09-era named hybrid (bow+valk tank strategy under old synergy-less math); era-specific canon proving named-build culture predates 1.10.
Deploys stationary trap emitters (Lightning/Death Sentry) that fire autonomously; Death Sentry chains corpse explosions. Player is a placer-of-turrets, not an attacker.
Chaos-runeword claws grant Whirlwind to the Assassin; borrowed-spin melee with claw speed math.
Dragon Talon multi-kick with crushing-blow stacking; percent-HP boss shredder identity.
Martial-arts charge-up system: build elemental charges with Phoenix/Claws-of-Thunder strikes, finishers consume (Mosaic makes charges persist) releasing multi-element novae and chains.
PvP-named hybrid: Mind Blast stunlock + traps + claw WW burst; control-chain dueling identity.
Blade skills (Fury/Sentinel/Shield) chronically undertuned pre-D2R; documented dead branch for two decades.
The genre's spin-to-win origin: channel-move through packs dealing weapon hits along the path; entire output weapon-scaled physical.
Dual-wield attack-speed stacker: Frenzy hits ramp self-haste; momentum melee limited by physical-immune density.
Berserk converts to magic damage at the cost of zero defense while swinging — the all-in single-target trade.
Uninterruptible defensive single-target swing; the safe-melee identity and hardcore staple.
Caster barbarian: War Cry stun-nukes in a radius off mana; the class's shout tree played as the whole kit — beloved inversion canon.
Utility loop canon: kill lightly, then Find Item re-rolls corpses for loot — the economy-verb-as-build proof.
Double Throw dual-thrown-weapon ranged warrior; 2.4 buffs promoted a two-decade meme into real canon.
Tornado throws erratic-path physical-magic twisters while Hurricane spins a cold aura around the body; the wandering-rotator archetype with a summon wall.
Fissure erupts ground vents under packs; Armageddon rains a meteor storm around the moving body — zone caster with a body-attached bombardment.
Shapeshift into werewolf form — a different stat-and-skill body — then Fury multi-bite at extreme attack speed; the form IS the kit.
Werewolf bite spreads a contagious poison that jumps target-to-target; DoT plague delivered by a shapeshifted melee body.
Bear form stacks Maul damage charges per hit; slow heavy swings, tank identity, the other half of the form-shift family.
Full menagerie — wolves, bear, ravens, vines — commanding a mixed pet wall while the druid supports; K24's direct source.
Werewolf whose claws deal fire via Fire Claws synergy stack — form-shift melee wearing an elemental damage identity.
Skeleton army + Amplify Damage + Corpse Explosion chain: kills make corpses, corpses make bombs and soldiers — the corpse-economy engine and K17's source.
Bone Spear/Spirit magic-damage caster with Bone Prison control; PvP royalty and the immunity-proof caster archetype.
Poison Nova blankets the whole screen in an expanding DoT ring on cooldown cadence, Lower Resist amplifying; sweep-and-move plague caster.
Poison Dagger melee necromancer made semi-real by 2.4 — a shallow-canon curiosity proving the buff-promotes-build pattern.
Golem-as-primary-damage never worked across two decades; golems are utility bodies, not engines — documented dead-as-main branch.
Blessed Hammers spiral outward from the cast point in a fixed pattern; magic damage ignores nearly all immunities; the genre's canonical spiral-orbiter and K20's source.
Smite shield-bashes with auto-hit, stun, and crushing-blow percent-HP shred — THE uber-boss executioner role build.
Zeal locks a five-hit melee flurry per click under self-Fanaticism; commitment-locked swing sequence, weapon-scaled.
Fist of the Heavens strikes targeted lightning with holy-bolt shrapnel; 2.4 removed the casting delay and a PvP classic became PvE canon — the buff-rebirth lineage exemplar.
Vengeance melee converts each swing into tri-element damage under Conviction — the immunity-proof melee answer.
Charge gap-closes with a massive single hit; PvP burst identity where the movement verb IS the damage skill.
Stacked item-granted auras (Dream Holy Shock, Dragon Holy Fire) pulse passive damage around the moving body while Zeal delivers; gear-defined passive-pulse identity.
PvP-named Whirlwind barbarian tuned to hunt casters — Leap stun, WW intercepts, BO stack; the named-comp culture's flagship (listed under Barbarian; filed near Paladin PvP row per source ordering).
Blizzard hails a fixed zone with falling ice on a cast-delay cadence; the MF-farming queen and ladder-start default for two decades.
Frozen Orb travels then shatters, spraying radial ice bolts along its whole path; low-invest one-point wonder and the projectile-that-emits archetype.
Fire Meteor tree + cold Frozen Orb tree in one kit — the genre's canonical dual-element chain-partition, born from immunity coverage; K-roster anchor for E3.
Fire Ball spam with Meteor drops on packs; methodical placement caster planning impact zones.
Lightning/Chain Lightning with massive variance dice and Infinity resist-break; go-anywhere kill-anything once 117 FCR and gear assemble — the ceiling build of the class.
Nova rings expand from the body at spam cadence; point-blank screen-clear caster living inside melee range by choice.
Summons stationary fire-spitting hydra emitters on short cooldowns and repositions while they shoot — turret-caster identity made real by 2.4.
Enchant converts the sorceress (and party/mercenary) into fire-melee attackers; self-buff-as-build plus external scaling — the buff-economy oddity canon.
1.09's dominant caster: Firewall zone damage before synergies existed; era-canon proving zone-DPS supremacy under old math.
RotW expansion class flagship melee: Echoing Strike repeats/echoes hits; dominated S13 ladder, brought down some in patch 3.2 yet still top-tier. SEARCH-DERIVED (post-cutoff content).
Blood Boil synergy now feeds Summon Tainted, making a blood-caster/summon pairing S-tier — blood-cost-flavored caster in the new class. SEARCH-DERIVED.
Bind Demon converts enemies into companions, then consumes them — an enemy-conversion summon economy (reap-adjacent verb in official D2!). SEARCH-DERIVED.
Magic-school caster archetype of the Warlock (reworked magic skills, no immunity worries). SEARCH-DERIVED; details thin.
Fire-school Warlock; slightly nerfed in 3.2 but S-tier with proper gear. SEARCH-DERIVED; details thin.
Named in current tier lists alongside Hammerdin/LF/Frozen Orb; mechanics unharvested. SEARCH-DERIVED; dossier owed.
Impale: huge single hit, brutal weapon durability cost, glacial recovery — the textbook trap skill for twenty years.
Inferno's channel flame cone under-delivered its listed damage for decades (infamous breakpoint bug); the canonical dead channel skill.
Blaze leaves a fire trail behind the running caster — movement-paints-damage inversion that never produced a viable loop (run-in-circles meme).
Corpse-totem fear ward nobody took for twenty years (2.5 reworked it into a real buff — buffed-because-dead exemplar).
Leap Attack as main damage never sustained a loop — the movement verb was the value, the damage was the pretense; utility skill miscast as a build.
